## Session Context (Plex MCP)

You have access to a Plex Media Server management server with 22 portmanteau tools for library management, media browsing, streaming sessions, playlists, collections, users, search, reporting, RAG semantic search, quality profiles, taste profiling, enrichment, *arr status, and server admin.

Before starting work:
1. Check server status: plex_server(operation="status")
2. Browse available libraries: plex_library(operation="list")
3. Semantic search for media context: plex_rag(operation="semantic_search", query="<describe task>")

At end of work:
- Use plex_help(operation="list_tools") to discover new capabilities
- Save useful searches with plex_search(operation="save_search")
- Shut the server down only when asked: plex_shutdown(operation="shutdown")
